prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 13 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1268; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a wrist fracture, and the reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the crash. Initial imaging confirmed the fracture, and the patient was immobilized and then transitioned to a structured rehabilitation plan. Over the course of thirteen visits, treatment extended somewhat beyond the typical timeframe for this injury, reflecting a slower-than-expected return to function. Examination findings include localized tenderness and reduced grip strength on the affected side that support the diagnosis, while several other tests, including neurovascular assessment and sensation, returned normal. No prior injury to the same area is known from the patient history. Billing records reflect single, non-duplicated charges for each service rendered. Ongoing monitoring continues, with restrictions on heavy lifting maintained until radiographic and functional healing is confirmed.
